data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a significant strengthening of prior year provisions by $234.2 million in 2024. This adverse development was influenced by mid-sized losses in Energy and Aviation, ongoing geopolitical events such as the Russia/Ukraine conflict and the Hamas/Gaza conflict, and inherent reserving challenges in longer-tail lines like Casualty. The Syndicate also applies a prudence margin and regularly reviews claims development and IBNR estimates.
raw_causal_phrases: mid-sized losses on the Energy, Power and Aviation books

longer tail lines, such as casualty, remain a small proportion of the overall book, these lines, due to their very nature, are more difficult to reserve for and will, over time, increase the inherent risk within this principal risk
judgement is applied when estimating the value of amounts that should be provided for claims that have been incurred at the reporting date but have not yet been reported (IBNR) to the Syndicate
a management prudence margin is added to the actuarial best estimate
claims development is monitored against expectations
